blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. We start slow, and you can do it!

Products come into the warehouse and go out to the customer. Stock moves from the truck to the shelf. Every movement is registered.

Today you will learn five important words: stock in, stock out, inventory, shelf and record. You will also practise small prepositions of movement — in, out, into, from and to. They are small words, but they show the direction of the stock.

items.q: Where do the products come into?
items.why: "Products come into the warehouse." — o estoque entra no armazém.

items.q: The stock moves from the truck to the…
items.why: "Stock moves from the truck to the shelf."

items.q: What happens to every movement?
items.why: "Every movement is registered." — todo movimento é registrado.

items.q: The text says "we start slow." This suggests that…
options: you must already speak English well
the class will finish very fast
the lesson is easy to follow step by step
the words are very hard to learn
items.why: Inferência: "start slow" + "you can do it" mostra um tom acolhedor, passo a passo.

items.q: Why does the text call the prepositions "small but important"?
options: Because they show the direction of the stock
Because they are difficult to write
Because they are the longest words
items.why: Inferência: in, out, into, from, to são curtas, mas dizem para onde o estoque vai.

blocks.instruction: Ouça o funcionário mais experiente treinando um novo colega no armazém. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning! Today I show you how the stock moves. It is easy. We go slow.

Look. This truck brings new products. The products come into the warehouse. This is stock in. We take them out of the boxes and we put them on the shelf. Not in the shelf — on the shelf. The word is "on".

Now, a customer buys a product. The product goes out to the customer. This is stock out. Stock goes in, and stock goes out. Very simple.

But listen — this part is important. Every time you move a product, you write a record. From the truck to the shelf: record. From the shelf to the customer: record. The record keeps the inventory right.

Why do we do this? Because a good record saves hours of work. If the numbers are wrong, we look for the product all day. If the record is good, we find it in one minute.

Listen to the preposition. In, out, into, from, to. The preposition tells you the movement. Small words, big help. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does the truck bring?
items.why: "This truck brings new products. The products come into the warehouse."

items.q: Where do you put the products?
items.why: "We put them on the shelf. Not in the shelf."

items.q: What must you write every time you move a product?
items.why: "Every time you move a product, you write a record."

items.q: Why is a good record important, according to the speaker?
options: Because it looks nice on paper
Because it saves hours of work finding the product
Because the customer asks for it
items.why: Inferência: "a good record saves hours of work… we find it in one minute."

items.q: How would you best describe the speaker's tone?
options: Patient and encouraging with the new colleague
items.why: Inferência: "We go slow… Very simple… You can do it!" mostra paciência e incentivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "When the truck arrives, we register the stock in." Stock in means…
items.why: Stock in = entrada de estoque, produtos que entram.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The customer bought ten boxes, so we register a big ___."
items.why: Produto que sai para o cliente é stock out = saída de estoque.

items.q: "We count everything to check the inventory." Inventory is…
options: the list of all products we have
items.why: Inventory = inventário, o total de produtos que temos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please put the new boxes on the ___, not on the floor."
items.why: Shelf = prateleira, o lugar certo para guardar os produtos.

items.q: "After each movement, we write a record." A record is…
items.why: Record = registro, a anotação de cada movimento.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia do armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We are almost empty. We need to stock up before Monday." To stock up means to…
options: buy more and fill the stock
items.why: Stock up = abastecer, encher o estoque de novo.

items.q: "Be careful, we can run out of boxes today." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem, acabar o que se tinha.

items.q: "When the delivery arrives, please put away the products." To put away means to…
options: store them in the right place
items.why: Put away = guardar as coisas no lugar certo.

items.q: "Before the truck leaves, we check in every box." To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = registrar e conferir a entrada dos itens.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the new inventory." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.
